item.title: Oceanfront Lahaina Property Owners May Get Buyout In Updated Disaster Plan
item.description: The county is seeking an amendment to create a voluntary buyout program with some of its $1.6 billion fire recovery grant from the feds.

item.title: Ed Case Has Substantial Lead In Money Race For U.S. House Seat
item.description: But state Rep. Jarrett Keohokalole has mounted a strong challenge and has attracted significant donors.

item.title: The State Capitol Is Buzzing About This Prominent Hawaiʻi Lawmaker
item.description: Longtime Sen. Michelle Kidani may be leaving office early amid concerns about whether she is mentally fit.

item.title: The Sunshine Blog: A Face Mask Ban For Cops Picks Up Early Momentum
item.description: Short takes, outtakes, our takes and other stuff you should know about public information, government accountability and ethical leadership in Hawai‘i.

item.title: Word Search: Viva Las Vegas
item.description: A puzzle in honor of the 9th Island.

item.title: A New Era Of Police Surveillance Is Coming To Hawai‘i
item.description: Drones are already used by law enforcement for special operations, but the program coming to Waikīkī marks a major increase in police surveillance and will be the first time Hawaiʻi uses drones as first responders.

item.title: Hawaiʻi’s Cost Of Living Is High. But There’s Another Huge Problem
item.description: A recent UH report likens Hawaiʻi's economy to that of West Virginia — another place being "left behind."

item.title: Hawaiʻi Homeowners Need More Options To Get Rid Of All Cesspools By 2050
item.description: State lawmakers are taking up a bill this week that would create a low-interest loan program.

item.title: Are Media Mergers Good For Hawaiʻi?
item.description: Massive consolidation is washing up on our shores. Let's hope state regulators are paying attention.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Sen. Michelle Kidani Says She’s Capable Of Handling Her Job
item.description: The 77-year-old lawmaker is trying to defuse concerns that she suffers from an illness that is affecting her performance.
